subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Water System Attacks
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Water System Attacks.

hook.text: In 2021, a hacker accessed a Florida water plant and tried to increase lye levels to 100 times normal.

buildup.text: Water treatment systems are often run by small utilities with minimal cybersecurity budgets and staff.

discovery.text: An operator noticed the mouse moving on his screen and stopped the attack manually just in time.

twist.text: The plant used TeamViewer with a shared password. The basics of security were completely missing.

climax.text: Critical infrastructure is only as secure as its weakest operator. Many are dangerously underfunded.

punchline.text: Shared password. Remote access. Nearly poisoned a city.

quiz.question: What security failure enabled the Florida water plant attack?
options: Shared password on remote access software
